I implemented the full translation logic: splitting the RNA into codons, mapping each codon to its amino acid, and stopping processing at the first STOP codon.", "file_path": "protein_translation.py", "content": "def proteins(strand):
    codon_map = {
        "AUG": "Methionine",
        "UUU": "Phenylalanine",
        "UUC": "Phenylalanine",
        "UUA": "Leucine",
        "UUG": "Leucine",
        "UCU": "Serine",
        "UCC": "Serine",
        "UCA": "Serine",
        "UCG": "Serine",
        "UAU": "Tyrosine",
        "UAC": "Tyrosine",
        "UGU": "Cysteine",
        "UGC": "Cysteine",
        "UGG": "Tryptophan",
        "UAA": "STOP",
        "UAG": "STOP",
        "UGA": "STOP",
    }
    stop_codons = {"UAA", "UAG", "UGA"}
    proteins = []
    for i in range(0, len(strand), 3):
        codon = strand[i:i+3]
        if codon in stop_codons:
            break
        proteins.append(codon_map[codon])
    return proteins
